integrity: The scalar two-factor zero-product probability and valuation adjacency criterion are credited to prior sources; finite computations corroborate rather than prove infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Fixed residue-field order and tuple size; no explicit general convergence rate for the higher-tuple asymptotics; publication priority beyond inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: Uniform-to-lattice transition for mutually annihilating tuples in finite chain rings
